MRVL.thesis_one_line: Marvell makes the AI chips that link data centers together and builds custom AI chips for Amazon-style cloud customers, but the stock already prices in years of strong growth.
kill_criteria: Data Center segment revenue growth below 20% YoY for two consecutive quarters (vs. +46% YoY in Q2 FY27)
Public disclosure that a top-3 hyperscaler custom-silicon program (>10% of revenue) has been re-bid, cancelled, or is being in-sourced by the customer
Non-GAAP gross margin below 57% (below the low end of the current 57.5-58.5% Q3 guide) for two consecutive quarters
Consolidated net debt/EBITDA (per the 10-Q balance sheet, run-rate annualized EBITDA) rising above 2.0x (currently roughly 0.3-0.5x)
NTM P/E above 55x with no corresponding upward revision to FY28 revenue guidance
key_adverse_facts: Quant model (b1) ranks MRVL in the bottom decile (live_rank 450, quintile 5) on value factors despite the triage's growth-driven advance -- a real, disclosed conflict, not resolved in MRVL's favor
Revenue and customer base concentrated in a small number of hyperscaler custom-silicon design wins that can be re-bid or in-sourced
Non-GAAP gross margin guide for Q3 FY27 (57.5-58.5%) is flat-to-down versus Q2 FY27 actual (58.9%)

Stockholders' equity and share count both rose materially from a $2.0bn NVIDIA Series A Convertible Preferred Stock issuance (2026-03-31) and stock-funded M&A (Celestial AI, XConn), diluting existing holders if converted
Insider Form-4 pattern and auditor identity were not independently checked this pass
data_conflicts: b1 quant composite score (bottom decile, live_rank 450/~1900) directly conflicts with the Q12 triage's qualitative advance (quality 4, growth 5); triage judgment overrode the quant rank on growth durability grounds, but the value-factor weakness is real given the 44.7x NTM P/E, not a data error
MRVL.horizon: 12-36 months, contingent on a valuation reset or confirmed multi-year Custom-silicon ramp
MRVL.confidence_in_thesis: medium: growth and design-win visibility are well evidenced in filings, but the valuation call depends on assumptions about multiple compression over a 3-year horizon that cannot be verified from filings alone

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 systematic valuation row exists for MRVL, so there is nothing to reconcile; my own reverse-DCF (NTM EPS ~$5.86, 15%/yr growth, multiple normalizing 44.7x to 25x) implies only ~1.5%/yr base-case return, i.e. the current price already assumes results at or above this base case, which is why the verdict is WATCH rather than INCLUDE.

MRVL.scenario_basis: Starting NTM consensus EPS $5.86 (d4 snapshot); bear: 15%/yr EPS growth, exit multiple 18x; base: 30%/yr EPS growth, exit multiple 25x; bull: 40%/yr EPS growth, exit multiple 40x; no meaningful dividend (yield 0.09%) added in any case.

TER.thesis_one_line: Teradyne makes the machines that test AI and memory chips before they ship, and business is booming, but the stock trades at a multi-year-high price for what may be cycle-peak earnings.
kill_criteria: A quarterly revenue guidance midpoint sequentially below the prior quarter's actual revenue for two consecutive quarters
Semiconductor Test segment revenue growth turns negative YoY (vs. +100%+ currently)
Consolidated GAAP operating margin below 20% for two consecutive quarters (Q1 2026 approx 37%, Q2 2026 approx 33%)
NTM P/E stays above 30x while quarterly guidance shows sequential deceleration for two straight quarters
Management's own commentary on 2027+ WFE/AI-test capex turns cautious or is walked back
key_adverse_facts: Q3 2026 guidance ($1.20-1.30bn revenue, $1.79-2.09 GAAP EPS) is a sequential step-down from Q2 2026's actual ($1.329bn, $2.38) even though it is a raise versus the two prior quarters' guided range
Semiconductor test-equipment demand is structurally tied to cyclical chipmaker capex, which has historically reversed sharply after AI-style demand spikes
FCF yield is only 0.7% against a 36.3x NTM P/E, indicating the market is capitalizing potentially cycle-elevated earnings at a rich multiple
Q1 2026 GAAP EPS ($2.53) was higher than Q2 2026 ($2.38) despite higher Q2 revenue; the driver was not disclosed in the headline release and was not resolved this pass
A 2026-08-10 8-K exhibit (Exhibit 10.1, an agreement) was identified but not opened this pass
TER.horizon: 12-24 months, on a valuation reset or confirmation that the 2027+ growth thesis is materializing quarter by quarter
TER.confidence_in_thesis: medium: the AI/HBM test demand and clean net-cash balance sheet are well evidenced, but the degree of cyclicality embedded in current earnings cannot be fully resolved from two years of filings alone

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 systematic valuation row exists for TER. My own reverse-DCF (NTM EPS ~$10.97, 15%/yr growth, multiple compressing 36.3x to 25x) implies only ~1.5%/yr base-case return, i.e. the current price already assumes results near or above this base case, consistent with a WATCH rather than INCLUDE verdict.

TER.scenario_basis: Starting NTM consensus EPS $10.97 (d4 snapshot), no meaningful dividend (yield 0.13%); bear: EPS falls to ~$8 by year 3 on a WFE-cycle downturn, exit multiple 15x (trough); base: 15%/yr EPS growth, exit multiple 25x; bull: 30%/yr EPS growth (2027+ AI-capex supercycle sustained), exit multiple 35x.

ACN.thesis_one_line: The world's largest IT consulting and outsourcing firm, priced at less than half its historical multiple, even though growth has genuinely slowed and new bookings just turned negative.
kill_criteria: Local-currency revenue growth below 3% (the bottom of the FY26 guide) for two consecutive quarters
New bookings YoY decline (USD) continuing for two more consecutive quarters (one quarter, Q3 FY26, already negative)
U.S. federal segment drag exceeding the guided approximately 1% impact on full-year local-currency growth
GAAP operating margin expansion stalling or reversing YoY (guided to 50-70bps of full-year FY26 expansion)
Consolidated net cash position falling below $2 billion (e.g. from debt-funded rather than cash-funded M&A)
key_adverse_facts: New bookings fell YoY in Q3 FY26 (-2% USD / -3% local currency) for the first time in this two-year window
U.S. federal government segment revenue pressure from 2025 federal budget/efficiency-driven contract reviews and terminations is an acknowledged, guided-for drag (~1% of FY26 growth)
Long-run risk that GenAI reduces demand/pricing for traditional staff-augmentation consulting, even as Accenture also sells GenAI integration work, is structural and unresolved
FY26 local-currency revenue-growth guidance was narrowed at the top end (5% cut to 4%) in the Q3 FY26 release even as EPS guidance was raised -- a mixed, not simply positive, signal
Dragos/runZero/NetRise acquisition (announced 2026-06-18) deal value was not disclosed in the release reviewed

Net cash fell from $5.0bn (2026-05-31) to $2.73bn (2026-08-31) after $5.0bn of senior notes (2026-07-10) and an extra $2bn of FY26 buybacks, only ~$0.7bn above the $2bn net-cash kill threshold (added by DV01)
data_conflicts: V1's base-case 3-year annualized return (30.2%/yr) implies a price above even the highest Street 12-month target ($275 vs $176.11 current), which V1 itself flags via street_flag; I use a more conservative base case (~11-13%/yr) given the Q3 FY26 bookings deceleration, so my dossier view is directionally consistent with V1 (both see the stock as cheap) but materially less optimistic on magnitude
ACN.confidence_in_thesis: medium: the valuation discount and balance-sheet strength are well evidenced, but whether the bookings decline is a one-off (federal noise) or the start of a GenAI-driven secular trend cannot be resolved before the imminent 2026-10-01 report

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: V1 and I agree ACN is statistically cheap (12x NTM P/E implying negative priced-in growth), but V1's base case assumes a full re-rating to historical multiples that its own street_flag notes would exceed the highest analyst price target; I use a more conservative base case (~11-13%/yr from ~6%/yr EPS growth plus a partial re-rating to 14-15x) that is still below what I believe ACN can deliver if the bookings deceleration stabilizes, keeping the INCLUDE-SMALL verdict valid under the implied-vs-base rule.

ACN.scenario_basis: Starting NTM consensus EPS $14.66 (d4 snapshot), dividend yield 3.7% included in all cases; bear: 2-3% LC growth, no re-rating (multiple stays ~12x); base: FY26-guided ~10% EPS growth decelerating to mid-single-digit, partial re-rating to 14-15x; bull: bookings reaccelerate on net-new GenAI demand, re-rating to 17-18x.
